maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly mortgage origination, plus life insurance and funeral services; these are new loans, policies and first-time services, not maintenance.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers, borrowers and families buying mortgages, insurance and funeral services; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through mortgage originations and insurance and funeral sales; acquisitions of insurers and mortuaries are occasional rather than the main driver.

mission_critical.reason: Mortgage borrowers can easily change lenders; funeral and life insurance purchases are one-off or replaceable, with low switching cost.

notes: Mortgage is believed to be the largest segment by revenue; the website text doesn't give segment sizes.
